chat_status.warning: Do not type health, disability, safeguarding, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, trade union, criminal, financial hardship or other special-category details, and do not paste resident contact details. Use the case record instead. Matching text is masked before it is saved, but masking can miss things.
chat_status.demo_disclaimer: Demonstration only. Answers are generated by an AI model from synthetic case facts, may be wrong, and are not reviewed or approved. No DPO, Legal or RAI approval exists. Check the sources.

limits.calls_per_request_basis: Cap of one model call per question. A question refused before the model is called uses none. When the provider reports no call count, one call is assumed.

memory_status.notice: Memory is off until you turn it on. It keeps short working preferences you choose, for you only. You can see, edit or delete every item, or clear all. It never holds resident or special-category data, never changes rules, ranking or permissions, and is never cited as evidence. Items expire when the approved retention period ends; it is Unknown until the DPO approves it.

chat_registry_entry.purpose: Answer questions about a case with cited sources; refuse approve, decide, consent, diagnose and resident-contact asks
chat_registry_entry.scope: constructed synthetic exercise only; no live resident, safety or financial processing
chat_registry_entry.permitted_capability: draft or propose text for a person to review; no write, send, approve or rank
chat_registry_entry.intended_use: Answer questions about a case with cited sources; refuse approve, decide, consent, diagnose and resident-contact asks
prohibited_uses: inferring refusal or vulnerability from silence or missing sensors
staff performance or emotion assessment without approval
changing, ranking, approving, signing or sending anything for a person
chat_registry_entry.influence: Cited reading aid; no write, approval or decision
chat_registry_entry.activation: disabled; enabling needs approved thresholds, a named accountable individual and the evidence in required_enablement_evidence

impact_record.note: Impact and residual-risk record is an open owner and qualified-reviewer item.

required_approval_evidence: task owner personal validation of own authority
DPO and Legal delegate personal validation
dated qualified UK and conditional EU intended-use, actor-role, influence and currentness review
chat_registry_entry.reliance_review: dated qualified UK and conditional EU review required before affected operational reliance; housing or hosting location alone does not decide applicability
chat_registry_entry.manual_route: Use the ordinary case controls and the named function; the panel answers nothing without a model.

demo_activation.basis: demo-only; the owner superseded DPO and Legal review for the demonstrator with a visible disclaimer
demo_activation.outstanding: DPO and Legal review outstanding; no Legal, DPO or RAI approval is recorded or implied
demo_activation.disclaimer: Demonstration only. Answers are generated by an AI model from synthetic case facts, may be wrong, and are not reviewed or approved. No DPO, Legal or RAI approval exists. Check the sources.

required_enablement_evidence: actual-model evaluation within a finite authorisation
